title: pnpm lockfile in the legacy v5 format
description: pnpm-lock.yaml declares a pnpm lockfile in the v5 format, which records less resolution provenance per package. Older formats record fewer fields per package, so the review sees a weaker graph than a current pnpm would give it.
remediation: Regenerate the lockfile with a current pnpm release.
limitation: It matches a pnpm lockfile in the v5 format, which records less resolution provenance per package in the parsed pnpm-lock.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
